issue.title: Prevent NullPointerException in TransportRolloverAction

labels.name: :Data Management/Indices APIs
labels.description: DO NOT USE. Use ":Distributed/Indices APIs" or ":StorageEngine/Templates" instead.

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
It's possible for the passed in `IndexMetaData` to be null (for
instance, cluster state passed in does not have the index in its
metadata) which in turn can cause a `NullPointerException` when
evaluating the conditions for an index. This commit adds null protection
and unit tests for this case.

Resolves #43296
